meta.title: Ved Umrajkar | Resume
meta.description: Resume of Ved Umrajkar, a student of Mathematics and Computing at IIT Roorkee.

paragraphs: Final-year BS-MS student in **Mathematics and Computing** at IIT Roorkee, focused on trustworthy machine learning, computer vision, and applied statistics for real-world systems.

Experience across macro-fee forecasting at JPMorgan Chase, risk analytics on Starknet at Hashstack Finance, and agentic evidence selection research at PavoAI — with papers at ICLR 2025, ICCV 2025, and KDD 2026.

bullets: Co-authored **“Agentic Evidence Selection for Decision-Making under Cognitive Constraints”** (KDD 2026 Research Track) [Paper](https://openreview.net/forum?id=htLPjsQy8a&noteId=htLPjsQy8a), formalising task-agnostic evidence selection as a **constrained submodular optimisation** problem.
Designed a framework combining **semantic anchor-based importance scoring** and diversity-aware selection, achieving **95.4%** of theoretical maximum semantic coverage without any task supervision.
Showed that importance-based pre-filtering retains **98% semantic coverage using only the top 20%** of evidence, generalising the pipeline to corpus-based retrieval architectures.

projects.title: Tree Ring Watermark Detection in Rectified Flow Models
bullets: Benchmarked Tree Ring watermark detectability and false-positive rates on DDIM (Stable Diffusion 2.1) vs **rectified flow transformers** (FLUX.1-dev) using standardized perturbation budgets.
Diagnosed inversion instability in rectified flows (FlowEuler, OT-CFM) and proposed robust watermark recovery settings for **text-to-image safety pipelines**.
Presented empirical limits, dataset curation, and statistical separability results at **ICLR 2025**, Singapore Expo.

projects.title: DAC-LoRA: Dynamic Adversarial Curriculum for VLMs
bullets: Introduced **DAC-LoRA**: LoRA adapters trained with progressively stronger PGD attacks to harden CLIP-style VLMs, presented at the *Workshop on Safe Multimodal AI Systems, ICCV 2025*.
Balanced **robust accuracy** and adaptation cost via small-rank adapters and curriculum pacing, outperforming vanilla LoRA and single-stage adversarial fine-tuning on few-shot benchmarks.

timeline.description: Dynamic Adversarial Curriculum for LoRA-based VLM fine-tuning, outperforming vanilla LoRA and single-stage adversarial training on few-shot benchmarks.

projects.title: Multi-Modal (Video-Text) Person Re-Identification
bullets: Building a video-text re-ID stack with tracklet encoders and a transformer text encoder, aligned via **contrastive and triplet losses** for open-vocabulary retrieval.
Running **ablation studies** on 5 benchmarks (MEVID, LSVID, ILIDS, Duke, G2A); reporting mAP/CMC gains from temporal pooling, query expansion, and hard-negative mining (ongoing).

projects.title: Voice Cloning with AutoRegressive Acoustic Models
bullets: Developed automated voice clones converting text into discretized acoustic tokens using **Tortoise-TTS**, tuning softmax temperature and mel spectrogram synthesis for high-fidelity output.
Built a **Streamlit** app for real-time voice clone generation, allowing users to upload `.wav` files to create custom voices.

projects.title: Multi-Risk Portfolio Optimization
bullets: Constructed S&P 500 portfolios with **Riskfolio**, maximizing Sharpe ratio while enforcing turnover and sector exposure constraints to keep allocations realistic.
Stress-tested allocations using standard deviation, **CVaR**, **MDD**, and MAD to quantify tail risk and drawdown resilience.
Ran **Monte Carlo bootstraps** and log-normal simulations for forward-looking return bands and downside probability estimates.

projects.title: ForecastPro
bullets: Built a hybrid forecaster combining **LSTNet** with classical **ARIMA/SARIMAX** baselines to cover seasonal, trend, and sudden-shift patterns.
Engineered lagged covariates, holiday flags, and rolling statistics; tuned ConvLSTM windows to stabilize long-horizon predictions.
Evaluated on AirQuality UCI and Yahoo Finance with **MAPE**/RMSE, showing consistent lift over pure statistical models.
